title: INTERIOR - HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES (THRONE ROOM)

texts.text: This architectural drawing presents two cross-sections of the interior of the Iolani Palace's Throne Room, showing the wall treatment and window/door details facing Richards Street and Punchbowl Street. The top section illustrates varied wall finishes including cornices, wood frames, plaster, and applied acoustical tile, while the bottom section shows a uniform plaster finish with louvered windows.
